body.p: Use the Checkout action in the Git History view to check out a commit. The Checkout dialog offers three modes:

ul.li: Switch to existing local branch — checks out a local branch that points to the selected commit.
Create a new branch — creates a new branch from the selected commit and checks it out.
Detached HEAD — checks out the commit without creating or switching to any branch.

section.title: Open Checkout Dialog
section.p: You must open the Checkout dialog to check out a commit unless only one local branch points to that commit.
To open the Checkout dialog, on Git History right-click a commit and select Checkout.

fig.title: Git History checkout from context menu

section.title: Switch to an Existing Local Branch
section.p: If only one local branch points to the selected commit, double-click the commit row to check out that branch and switch to it.

p.note:
Hover over a commit to see if the double-click shortcut is available. If it is, the Double-click to switch to this branch hint appears.
Double-click to switch to this branch hint

section.p: Alternatively, open the Checkout dialog and follow these steps:

ol.li: Select Switch to existing local branch.
(Optional) If multiple local branches point to the selected commit, choose which branch to check out from the dropdown list.
Select Checkout to check out and switch to the selected local branch.

section.title: Create a New Branch
section.p: To create and check out a new branch, open the Checkout dialog and follow these steps:

ol.li:
Choose Create a new branch.
Enter a unique branch name in Branch name.
If the commit has a tracked remote branch, on Track remote branch, choose a branch to track or select No tracking to create an untracked local branch.
Select Checkout to check out a new branch and switch to it from the selected commit.

section.p: The new branch is configured automatically and does not need further setup.

section.title: Create a Detached HEAD
section.p: To only view or make experimental changes to a branch, check out the commit as a detached HEAD.
To do so, open the Checkout dialog, choose Detached HEAD and select Checkout.

p.note: Changes made in a detached HEAD are temporary. To keep your changes, move them to an existing branch or create a new one.

section.p: An amber HEAD label appears next to the commit while in detached HEAD form.

body.note:
If you have uncommitted changes on your current branch, the Switch branch dialog appears and prompts you to stash or move changes, or cancel the switch to another branch.
